name: io.github.5dive-ai/5dive-mcp
summary: Expose the 5dive agent-fleet CLI (tasks, agents, digest) as MCP tools, over stdio or HTTP.

name: 5dive-mcp
summary: Manage a 5dive agent fleet: file tasks, message and inspect agents, and read the fleet digest.

name: 5Dive Cli
summary: Operate the local 5dive runtime: coordinate sibling agents and inspect or update shared tasks. Use for delegation, inter-agent messaging and task-queue operations; use `5dive-cli-extras` for runtime administration beyond those.

name: Compile Knowledge
summary: Compile durable, judgement-shaped knowledge into interlinked markdown — atomic files, [[wiki-links]], a maintained index. Use when persistence is asked for explicitly ("save this", "write it to the wiki") or when the work produced a decision record, a cause, or a gap analysis; ordinary factual answers and routine task results are not a trigger.

name: Openagent
summary: Author your own OpenAgent persona file and mint its shareable holo trading card — write, validate, tier and render `<id>.persona.yaml`. Use when creating or updating YOUR identity as a persona or card, or provisioning a live teammate from one.
